goalTitle: Close Cross-Repository Orchestration Capability Debt to a Green Surface
basis: The audit preserves supporting local evidence but does not promote unavailable Node 24, registry, Flutter SDK/cache, remote provider, clean root Git index, or canonical CI boundaries. Three implementation tasks are done, four environment-blocked tasks are cancelled, the documentation reconciliation task is active, and SuClos workflow integrity reports one missing typed executionAttempt timeline reference.

criteria.summary: Expected catalog, audit, reconciliation, status matrix, and backlog artifacts exist and are linked, but unresolved partial rows remain.
Bootstrap contract evidence passes, but the full Node 24/frozen install/recursive submodule run is not verified in the managed sandbox.
Deterministic checker and mismatch injection pass, but the current Flutter child commit is not yet recorded in the root gitlink because the managed root Git index is not writable.
Tracked-tree, available-artifact, consumer-manifest, and workflow scans now pass locally; five candidate artifact roots remain unavailable and canonical/public artifact evidence is not claimed.
Static child-CI workflow contracts pass and Flutter standalone MCP pin was corrected in child commit 3a9f776, but root pointer promotion and live CI/provider artifact evidence are unavailable.
Local static/fixture checks are preserved, but Node 24, registry, Flutter SDK/cache, remote provider, and public canonical runs are not available at the required boundaries.

Capability-map documents and current evidence links are reconciled; the status matrix now records 21 implemented and 18 partial rows, preserving actionable environment and pointer boundaries rather than reclassifying them as green.

SuClos records three done tasks, four cancelled environment-blocked tasks, one active documentation task, no follow-ups, and one workflow-integrity error; terminal native goal validation cannot pass yet.
